entities.name: Nikolaus II, Prince Esterházy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicholas II, Prince Esterházy was a Hungarian prince. He served the Austrian Empire and was a member of the famous Esterházy family. He is especially remembered for his art collection and for his role as the last patron of Joseph Haydn.
